why: Real A-10A/A-10C windscreen: one flat armoured centre pane between two posts, a flat quarter pane each side (canted outward), the arch bow above; the frameless blown bubble aft stays curved (War Thunder / DCS A-10C external models, A-10 photographs; the layout is the one the canopy script was built on). The HUD combiner (also in CanopyGlass) is excluded by the box z ranges.
